name: TMGMT Auto Translate Manager
project_description:
The TMGMT Auto Translate Manager module extends the Translation Management Tool (TMGMT) by adding automatic translation capabilities using continuous jobs. It allows you to configure and automate the translation of content entities based on specific thresholds and settings.

 The goal is to remove the manual "request translation", "add to cart", "review" step in the TMGMT workflow.

 Features 
 
 Automatic translation of content entities using TMGMT. 
 Configurable thresholds for updated content inclusion. 
 Support for multiple entity types and bundles. 
 Integration with TMGMT continuous jobs. 
 Automatic submission of translation jobs on cron. (This requires auto submit enabled in the selected translator provider) 
 Customizable settings for source and target languages, providers, and more. 
 
 Configuration 
 
 Navigate to the configuration page: `/admin/tmgmt/auto-translate-manager`. 
 Select the translation provider, source language, and target language. 
 Configure the entity types and bundles to include for automatic translation. 
 Set thresholds for updated content inclusion. 
 Enable or disable automatic submission of translation jobs. 
 
 Requirements 
 The TMGMT module and its `tmgmt_content` submodule.

 Compatibility 
 This module is tested and compatible with the following modules:

 
 TMGMT DeepL Integration 
 
 Troubleshoot 
 
 Check DB logs 
 Check any error message at `/admin/tmgmt/auto-translate-manager` 
 Check status page `/admin/reports/status`
